words.definition: n. 橡树；橡木 adj. 橡木的

examples.en: The old oak in the square is over three hundred years old.
examples.zh: 广场上的老橡树已有三百多年树龄。

examples.en: The heavy door is made of solid oak.
examples.zh: 这扇沉重的门由实心橡木制成。

words.usage: 名词指橡树、栎树，木材义橡木：solid oak 实心橡木、oak beams 橡木梁。谚语 Mighty oaks from little acorns grow 合抱之木生于毫末。
words.mnemonic: 音似「欧克」→ 欧洲常见大树 → 橡树

examples.en: The cattle were driven down to the river to drink.
examples.zh: 牛群被赶到河边饮水。

examples.en: Ranchers round up their cattle twice a year.
examples.zh: 牧场主每年两次把牛赶拢清点。

words.usage: 集合名词，形式单数、意义复数，谓语用复数：The cattle are grazing。「一头牛」说 a head of cattle。广义牲畜用 livestock。

synonyms.note: 母牛们，口语个体化说法

collocations: a herd of cattle 一群牛
words.mnemonic: cat+tle：猫大的牛犊长成牛群；只作复数

examples.en: The garden is a neat rectangle divided into four beds.
examples.zh: 花园是个规整的矩形，分成四块苗床。

examples.en: The area of a rectangle is its length times its width.
examples.zh: 矩形的面积等于长乘以宽。

words.usage: 数学词汇「长方形、矩形」；派生 rectangular adj. 矩形的（-angular 拼写易错）。构词 rect（直）+angle（角）→ 四直角图形，同根 rectify 校正、correct 正确，可串记。

synonyms.note: 正方形，四边相等的矩形

words.mnemonic: rect（直）+angle（角）→ 四个直角的图形 → 矩形

examples.en: The Persian Gulf states export vast quantities of crude oil every year.
examples.zh: 波斯湾各国每年出口大量原油。

examples.en: A widening gulf between rich and poor threatens social stability.
examples.zh: 不断扩大的贫富鸿沟威胁着社会稳定。

words.usage: 可数名词，本义「海湾」，引申指思想、群体间的「鸿沟」，常与 between 连用：the gulf between rich and poor；bridge the gulf 消除隔阂。程度比 gap 更深，难以逾越。

confusables.note: 高尔夫球，gulf 只差元音

collocations: gulf between rich and poor 贫富鸿沟
bridge the gulf 消除隔阂
words.mnemonic: 海湾 gulf 像大写 C 张口，隔出两岸「鸿沟」

examples.en: The beach is covered with smooth grey pebbles polished by the waves.
examples.zh: 海滩上铺满被海浪磨光的光滑灰色卵石。

examples.en: The boy skipped a flat pebble across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 男孩用扁平的卵石在平静的湖面上打水漂。

words.usage: 可数名词「卵石」，指被水流长期冲磨成的小圆石，形容词 pebbly 多卵石的。习语 not the only pebble on the beach 并非唯一合适的人选。常见搭配 skip pebbles 打水漂。
words.mnemonic: 谐音「啪啵」——浪拍卵石啪啵响

words.definition: n. 大陆，洲；adj. 自制的，克制的（罕）

examples.en: Antarctica is the coldest and driest continent on Earth.
examples.zh: 南极洲是地球上最冷、最干燥的大陆。

examples.en: The theory of continental drift explains how the continents have moved apart.
examples.zh: 大陆漂移说解释了各大陆如何漂移分开。

words.usage: 可数名词「大陆、洲」；英式 the Continent 特指欧洲大陆。派生 continental adj. 大陆的，如 continental climate 大陆性气候、大陆漂移说。
collocations: the Antarctic continent 南极大陆
words.mnemonic: cont(inue) 连成一体 → 连绵不断的整块陆地

words.definition: n. 爬行动物；卑劣的人

examples.en: Snakes and lizards are reptiles that cannot regulate their own body temperature.
examples.zh: 蛇和蜥蜴是无法调节自身体温的爬行动物。

examples.en: Fossils show that reptiles appeared long before mammals did.
examples.zh: 化石表明爬行动物远早于哺乳动物出现。

words.usage: 可数名词「爬行动物」，如蛇、蜥蜴、龟、鳄，属冷血动物，生物类文章常与 mammal 哺乳动物、amphibian 两栖动物并列对比。派生 reptilian adj. 爬虫的；（喻）冷血刻薄的。

confusables.note: 不情愿的，re- 开头易混

collocations: cold-blooded reptile 冷血爬行动物
reptile species 爬行动物物种
extinct reptiles 灭绝的爬行动物
words.mnemonic: rept(爬)＋ile → 贴地爬行的冷血动物

examples.en: The villagers gathered at the local pub to watch the football match.
examples.zh: 村民们聚在本地酒馆看足球赛。

examples.en: That 17th-century pub has served travelers for three hundred years.
examples.zh: 那家 17 世纪的酒馆已款待旅人三百年。

words.usage: 英式口语名词「酒馆」，由 public house 缩略，是英国社交核心场所。搭配 go to the pub 去酒馆、a pub lunch 酒馆午餐；美式对应词为 bar。
collocations: go to the pub 去酒馆
a pint at the pub 在酒馆喝一品脱
words.mnemonic: public house 缩成 pub，英国人扎堆据点

words.definition: n. 屠夫，肉贩；刽子手；vt. 屠宰；拙劣地弄糟

examples.en: The butcher trimmed the fat from the pork with great skill.
examples.zh: 肉贩熟练地剔除了猪肉上的肥膘。

examples.en: Critics claimed the director butchered the classic novel in adapting it.
examples.zh: 评论家称导演在改编中糟蹋了这部经典小说。

words.usage: 名词「屠夫、肉贩」，喻指「刽子手」；及物动词「屠宰」，引申「拙劣地搞砸」：butcher the film 把影片改得一团糟。派生 butchery n. 屠宰；大屠杀。英式 the butcher's 即肉铺。
words.mnemonic: butch(粗壮)＋er → 粗壮大汉操刀屠宰

words.definition: n. 步枪，来复枪；vt. 快速翻找，盗取

examples.en: The soldiers carefully cleaned their rifles before the inspection.
examples.zh: 士兵们在检查前仔细擦拭步枪。

examples.en: She rifled through the drawer in search of the missing key.
examples.zh: 她翻遍抽屉寻找丢失的钥匙。

words.usage: 名词「步枪」，枪管内刻 rifling 膛线而得名；及物动词「翻找、盗取」：rifle through the drawers 翻遍抽屉。搭配 an automatic rifle 自动步枪。
collocations: rifle through drawers 翻遍抽屉
words.mnemonic: 音译「来复」——枪管刻来复线的步枪

examples.en: The children flew kites in the park on the windy afternoon.
examples.zh: 起风的午后，孩子们在公园里放风筝。

examples.en: A red kite circled high above the field, searching for prey.
examples.zh: 一只红鸢在田野上空高高盘旋觅食。

words.usage: 名词两义：「风筝」与猛禽「鸢」。习语 fly a kite 放风筝；喻「放风声、试探舆论」。as high as a kite 烂醉如泥。相关猛禽 hawk、eagle 常并现。
words.mnemonic: 凯特（Kate 谐音）在风里放风筝

examples.en: She swept the fallen leaves into a pile with a broom.
examples.zh: 她用扫帚把落叶扫成一堆。

examples.en: A new broom sweeps clean, and the new manager changed everything overnight.
examples.zh: 新官上任三把火，新经理一夜之间改了一切。

words.usage: 名词「扫帚」，动词「扫除」。谚语 A new broom sweeps clean 新官上任三把火。复合词 broomstick 扫帚柄。jump the broom 为旧俗「跳扫帚成婚」。
collocations: new broom 新扫帚；新上任者
words.mnemonic: b＋room → 每个房间都该有一把扫帚

examples.en: Children with siblings often learn to share earlier than only children.
examples.zh: 有兄弟姐妹的孩子常比独生子女更早学会分享。

examples.en: The study examined sibling rivalry in families of different sizes.
examples.zh: 该研究考察了不同规模家庭中的手足竞争。

words.usage: 可数名词，「兄弟姊妹」的统称，不分性别，口语常说 brother or sister，多用于学术正式语境。固定搭配 sibling rivalry 手足竞争，心理学阅读高频。
collocations: have no siblings 独生无同胞
words.mnemonic: sib(同胞)＋ling(小) → 同胞手足

words.definition: n. 毛巾，纸巾；vt. 用毛巾擦干

examples.en: He wrapped a towel around his waist after taking a shower.
examples.zh: 淋浴后他在腰间围了一条毛巾。

examples.en: She toweled her hair dry before rushing out of the house.
examples.zh: 她用毛巾擦干头发就匆匆出了门。

words.usage: 名词「毛巾」，动词「用毛巾擦干」：towel one's hair dry。习语 throw in the towel 认输、放弃，源自拳击。搭配 bath towel 浴巾、paper towel 纸巾。
collocations: throw in the towel 认输
words.mnemonic: tow(拖)＋el → 拖过身体擦水的布

words.definition: n. 松鼠；vt. 贮存，藏匿

examples.en: Squirrels gather nuts in autumn to survive the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 松鼠在秋天囤积坚果以熬过严冬。

examples.en: For years she squirreled away part of her salary for emergencies.
examples.zh: 多年来她悄悄攒下一部分工资以备急用。

words.usage: 名词「松鼠」；动词 squirrel sth away 偷偷攒下、藏起：squirrel away savings 攒积蓄，财经阅读常见。英美读音差异大：英 ˈskwɪrəl，美 ˈskwɜːrəl。
collocations: squirrel away nuts 储存坚果
words.mnemonic: squ(eeze)挤＋irrel → 腮帮挤满坚果的囤粮高手

words.definition: n. 理发师（多服务男士）

examples.en: The barber trimmed his hair and shaved his beard with care.
examples.zh: 理发师细心地为他剪发修须。

examples.en: An old barber pole still spins slowly outside the shop.
examples.zh: 一根老式理发彩柱仍在店外缓缓旋转。

words.usage: 可数名词「（主要为男士理发的）理发师」，女士美发师称 hairdresser。搭配 barber shop 理发店、barber pole 理发店彩柱。派生 barbering 理发业。
collocations: go to the barber's 去理发
words.mnemonic: barb(倒刺)＋er → 剃净「毛刺」的人

examples.en: She raised an eyebrow at the price on the menu.
examples.zh: 看到菜单上的价格，她挑了挑眉。

examples.en: The mayor's luxury car raised eyebrows among local taxpayers.
examples.zh: 市长的豪车令当地纳税人侧目。

words.usage: 可数名词「眉毛」，常以复数出现。高频短语 raise an eyebrow 扬眉表惊讶或不赞同：The price raised eyebrows 令人侧目。brow 兼指眉与额。
collocations: raise an eyebrow 挑眉（表惊讶）
words.mnemonic: eye＋brow(额) → 眼上额部之毛

examples.en: The church choir sings carols every Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 教堂唱诗班每个平安夜都唱颂歌。

examples.en: She has sung in the school choir since she was ten.
examples.zh: 她从十岁起就在学校合唱团演唱。

words.usage: 可数名词「唱诗班、合唱团」，集合名词。短语 preach to the choir 对已有共识者白费口舌。派生 choral adj. 合唱的。注意 ch 读 k。
collocations: join the choir 加入唱诗班
words.mnemonic: 同 chorus(合唱) 一族，法语尾 -oir → 唱诗班

examples.en: The old farmhouse was built of heavy oak timber.
examples.zh: 这座老农舍用厚实的橡木建成。

examples.en: The country exports softwood timber to furniture makers worldwide.
examples.zh: 该国向世界各地的家具商出口软木木材。

words.usage: 不可数名词「木材、木料」，建筑用；英式兼指「林木（资产）」，美式同义词 lumber。搭配 timber industry 木材业、timber house 木屋。

confusables.note: 音色，法语借词，b 不发音

words.mnemonic: 谐音「添木」——添置木料好盖房

examples.en: The bulb in the desk lamp burned out suddenly last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚台灯的灯泡突然烧坏了。

examples.en: Tulip bulbs are planted in autumn and bloom the following spring.
examples.zh: 郁金香球茎秋天种下，来年春天开花。

words.usage: 可数名词两义：「电灯泡」与「球茎」。a bulb goes on 灯亮，喻「恍然大悟」。搭配 change a bulb 换灯泡、plant bulbs 种球茎。
words.mnemonic: 灯泡与球茎同形，圆鼓鼓都叫 bulb
